title: Retatrutide vs Tirzepatide
summary: Retatrutide: tier human clinical trial, 197 indexed publications, 7 randomized trials. Tirzepatide: tier approved label, 2,756 indexed publications, 131 randomized trials. 8 indexed studies compare them directly; the head-to-head section quotes what they state.

seo.title: Retatrutide vs Tirzepatide: what the studies show
seo.description: Retatrutide vs Tirzepatide, side by side from each compound's own cited record, plus any direct head-to-head trial. Not advice.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, mice, 2026: Given the therapeutic potential of GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, and retatrutide) in diabetic nephropathy, we evaluated their anti-fibrotic and anti-inflammatory effects in non-diabetic renal fibrosis using HK-2 cells and murine UUO and aging models.
head_to_head.source_excerpt: Given the therapeutic potential of GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, and retatrutide) in diabetic nephropathy, we evaluated their anti-fibrotic and anti-inflammatory effects in non-diabetic renal fibrosis using HK-2 cells and murine UUO and aging models.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, mice, 2026: Recently, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogs, including semaglutide, tirzepatide, and retatrutide, have been explored as potential anti-obesity therapies.
head_to_head.source_excerpt: Recently, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogs, including semaglutide, tirzepatide, and retatrutide, have been explored as potential anti-obesity therapies.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, rats, 2026: We also evaluated acute treatment with tirzepatide, a dual GLP-1/gastric inhibitory peptide (GIP) receptor agonist, and retatrutide, a triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist, to determine whether broader receptor activity would differentially influence alcohol's subjective effects.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, mice, 2025: Retatrutide demonstrated superior effectiveness in reducing weight and improving renal function in db/db mice compared to Liraglutide and Tirzepatide.
head_to_head.source_excerpt: Retatrutide demonstrated superior effectiveness in reducing weight and improving renal function in db/db mice compared to Liraglutide and Tirzepatide.

head_to_head.value: Clinical trial, humans, n=3,236, 2026: A comprehensive literature search was conducted using PubMed, the Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar from inception to June 2025 to identify randomized controlled trials evaluating tirzepatide, retatrutide, or mazdutide in obese adults.
head_to_head.source_excerpt: A comprehensive literature search was conducted using PubMed, the Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar from inception to June 2025 to identify randomized controlled trials evaluating tirzepatide, retatrutide, or mazdutide in obese adults.

head_to_head.value: Clinical trial, humans, n=214, 2026: Compared with placebo, weight loss was greatest with retatrutide (-22.10%, 95% confidence interval -25.60% to -18.60%), followed by tirzepatide (-19.28%, -20.39% to -18.16%), and CagriSema (a combination of cagrilintide and semaglutide, -17.32%, -19.32% to -15.32%).
head_to_head.source_excerpt: Compared with placebo, weight loss was greatest with retatrutide (-22.10%, 95% confidence interval -25.60% to -18.60%), followed by tirzepatide (-19.28%, -20.39% to -18.16%), and CagriSema (a combination of cagrilintide and semaglutide, -17.32%, -19.32% to -15.32%).

head_to_head.value: In vitro study, humans, 2023: Although retatrutide may be superior to the GLP-1 receptor agonist dulaglutide in reducing plasma glucose and body weight, this is not a meaningful comparison, as another GLP-1 receptor agonist (semaglutide) is more potent than dulaglutide at this and may have similar efficacy to retatrutide.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, mice, 2025: It shows superior weight loss effects compared to tirzepatide and similar metabolic efficacy to retatrutide, despite significantly less potent GIPR activity.
